title: Advanced Book of the Rebounding Board
summary: Teaches how to send an opponent's own force back through the shield with a full meridian flow of qi.

title: Treatise on Shield and Spear Together
summary: Joins the shield to a thrusting spear under a living qi field that covers both weapons at once.

title: The Crushing Facing
summary: Gathers the heaviest bashes of the shield and the footwork that carries a bearer into them with full qi.

title: Canon of the Immovable Stance
summary: A canon on holding one spot behind the shield while the qi field absorbs and spreads every blow.

title: Higher Practice of the Edge Guard
summary: Refines the rim and edge of the shield into a guard that cuts and catches in one qi-driven motion.

title: The Twin-Court Shield Book
summary: Sets out the shield as one half of a pair held and moved with its partner on two tracks.

title: The Hawk-Wing Shield Forms
summary: Teaches wide sweeping shield forms that open like a hawk's wings and then fold shut in answer.

title: River-Turning Shield Methods
summary: Teaches the guard that lets a blow run past like a river bending round a stone and then returns it.

title: Azure Basin Guard Treatise
summary: A treatise on guarding a hollow of ground where partnered shields gather every blow into the centre.

title: Wind-Sworn Shield Bearing
summary: Teaches the sworn shield bearer to hold a bearing against the wind of an advancing enemy.

title: The Oath Shield Discipline
summary: Binds the bearer's footwork and guard to a standing oath that the shield never leaves the line.

title: Teachings of the Open Plateau Guard
summary: Teaches a shield guard for open ground on the plateau where no cover exists but the bearer's own board.

title: The Gale-Turning Board
summary: Shows how to turn a hard wind of attacks aside with a board that moves ahead of each blow.
